test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

1. MNOP : NMOP

2. ABCD : BACD

3. FGHI : GFHI

4. STUV : TSUV

5. WXYZ : XYWZ

options.text: M N O P : N M O P
A B C D : B A C D
W X Y Z : X Y W Z
S T U V : T S U V

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20392dd97a7a65f49c433cf0be88faa6ef66766c47ddcef86a2719df6a71ddf4.png] 

The logic followed here is,

For,

1. MNOP : NMOP

2. ABCD : BACD

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7846fcef10829aeda2b518075ac831b3ab196a974ce6e345cedd6b26a987971b.png] 

3. FGHI : GFHI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0beac3b3c8b498048dd573de5d929d71b60424caa418d37f55ddd9362152e5b.png] 

4. STUV : TSUV

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d737ba7b04db42f015efe3f2694d7be48706ea21d0d6a8c34d5c252de22f92db.png] 

**5. WXYZ : XYWZ**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/27664211bbe0afbc740b34dd6d18cc43a587592005c40b5099e49e575d9879c3.png] 

**"**WXYZ : XYWZ"** does not follow the same logic as others.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
